review.method: Static source and documentation comparison. Historical checkout was read only.
review.historical_metadata_limit: Historical root Cargo.toml and workspace/index/Cargo.toml contain stale workspace member and path references; old source is treated as capability and UX evidence, not as a buildable architecture or instruction source.
review.result: Current foundations cover shared command/presentation contracts, local-service transport, versioned storage, bounded discovery, seven syntax frontends, typed registry facts, and concrete search/vector/graph/projection adapters. Full parity is not established because desktop projections and onboarding, historical MCP/client setup compatibility, forge-only flows, live all-language multi-client journeys, and complete restart durability remain incomplete or unproven.

capability_inventory.finding: Shelf model and restore path exist, but project creation/selection is not connected to a durable project catalog and LocalEngineClient::request_root hardcodes backend_library::ProjectId::new(one) with one equal to 1.
Current empty shelf wording and ambient data-root startup exist, but an Add project action that creates a ready indexed project is not proven.
Typed transport and catalog paths exist, but the desktop lacks a complete visible loading, failure, retry, and stale-generation state.
Routes can name a project, but distinct durable projects and selection propagation are not shown.
Current command palette and retrieval authorities do not yet form a desktop omnibar with typed rows, trust sections, or federated structural/semantic results.
Action labels exist, but many key constants are definition-only and ActionId::shortcut uses cmd-* unconditionally; focus and platform binding need acceptance coverage.
Route identity and bounded history are modeled, but live route actions are not proven to open real document/source/graph projections.
Current lanes and typed package summaries exist, but bodies render requested-facts placeholders.
Command grammar is present, but reader/source projections include placeholder behavior.
Typed graph authority exists, but the desktop graph action currently opens the command palette.
Settings route names exist, but only a page label and reduced-motion toggle are rendered; connection, index, registry, agents, and diagnostics controls are not wired.

Local-first startup and authenticated loopback replace the account gate, but current desktop has no visible credential/setup/status contract. Historical platform-specific sign-in wording is a wrong-language regression guard.
Current emits one tool per 40 command grammars plus backend.query and backend.surface. Old nine names need explicit aliases, a compatibility profile, or a documented breaking change.
Current schemas are generated and bounded, but old result details, errors, resource URIs, and semantics are not shown wire-compatible.
A current resource module exists; exact URI and payload parity needs an explicit contract check.
Current loopback HTTP, stdio, session limits, and bounded frames preserve transport foundations, but desktop does not expose visible endpoint status or copyable config.
Retry policy is explicit and avoids mutation replay, but idle reconnect, session replacement, error payloads, and client recovery need live coverage.
Shared registry covers old command domains and adds projects, forges, subscriptions, tree, health, and revisions; exact aliases and output details need a compatibility matrix.
Multiple formats and detail levels exist, but consistency for every old record and typed unavailable state is unproven.
Local-service owns source ingestion and registry acquisition; the old long-running catalog/feed/Homebrew loop is gone and needs a replacement journey for progress, watermarking, and restart.
Authenticated local service consolidates ownership and transports; equivalence of old route-level results and readiness behavior is not established.
Typed objects, relations, and release facts cover many fields, but there is no complete mapping artifact for every old table, historical read, watermark, location, and projection field.
Greenfield storage is a sound foundation and no migration is required, but product_state lacks file/parent fsync and corrupt-state recovery is not proven end to end.
Concrete adapter and bounded lexical authority exist; exact field, ranking, schema-version, watermark, and partial-index parity need mapping and a live gate.
Current vector contracts exist, but old local/remote embedding and indexing behavior is not proven through current desktop, CLI, and MCP.
Typed graph composition and grammar exist; live package graph and symbol references remain unproven in desktop/MCP.
Seven current frontends match the historical baseline and grammar adds C/C++; live multi-client journeys and C#/JavaScript/TypeScript MCP remain unproven.
Current per-file TooLarge is typed and scanning continues, but generated-file filtering plus one oversized file needs a combined journey.
Current statically filters target, node_modules, dist/build/bin/obj/coverage and honors nested .gitignore without Git subprocess; multi-file behavior still needs the gate.
Cargo, Npm, PyPI, Maven, NuGet, Go, and Cpp/Conan identities and typed facts exist; live seven-ecosystem coverage is outstanding.
Command names exist, but product state returns forge-unavailable and no current GUI forge onboarding or source-history surface was found.
Typed exact/approximate/not-reported, standing, and advisory states exist; desktop release/security lanes remain placeholders.
Per-platform ambient data roots and Windows transport paths exist; shortcut labels, credential wording, and reconnect need platform gates.
Desired journeys and atomic desktop state writes exist; identity retention, product-store durability, offline cache, and corrupt recovery are not all demonstrated.
workspace2 is a duplicate transition architecture and must not return as a second command, MCP, or storage authority.

useful_product_behavior: Project panel visibly distinguishes loading, ready, failed, and empty states; an empty corpus explains how to add/configure a project.
One keyboard-accessible search surface combines structural and semantic results with typed rows, trust/provenance, focus, and Escape behavior.
Package and symbol pages retain one selected identity while exposing dependencies, dependents, releases, security, source, documentation, and references.
MCP setup shows endpoint status, a copyable client configuration, and recovery after restart or port change.
Registry facts distinguish exact, approximate, unavailable, withheld, and privileged values and preserve standing/security/provenance; unknown is not zero.
Indexing reports progress and typed failures, ignores generated/build directories before descent, honors nested .gitignore, and continues after one oversized file.
legacy_debt_to_exclude: Stale root/index manifests and vendor-specific patches from the historical checkout.
Historical ProjectStore incrementing-ID skeleton and forward-declared dependency stubs.
Old account/cloud-gate assumptions that do not belong in local-first operation.
Historical platform wording that labels every credential as macOS Keychain.

parity_journeys.gate: From an empty per-user root, add two real local projects, observe progress, select each, and see a non-empty catalog or typed failure. Shelf and active project are visible; no silent empty corpus.
After selecting project, package, document, and source line, close/reopen and restore the same valid identity and catalog.
With a warm root and network disabled, cached package/document facts remain browseable; missing remote fields are typed offline/unavailable and no request hangs.
Corrupt desktop state and product temp/journal in a copy; startup recovers or reports a diagnostic while preserving the durable root, never silently replacing it with empty state.

Use live real packages in Cargo, Npm, PyPI, Maven, NuGet, Go, and Conan/C++. Show coordinates, versions, dependencies/dependents where available, download standing, release standing, security, and acquisition errors.
Add a GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, or generic HTTPS revision without a registry coordinate, show repository/source provenance, and return typed unavailable offline.

For Rust, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java, C#, C, and C++, index a real fixture and perform search/read/source/references/graph through CLI, MCP, and desktop; C# and JS/TS have explicit MCP cases.

Verify stdio and loopback /mcp, bearer/session reconnect, tools/list and tools/call schemas, result/error envelopes, resources/list/read, mutation no-replay, repeatable-read retry, and Claude-compatible copied configuration. Decide old nine names alias or breaking change.

Exercise add/select project, package lanes, source/docs/graph, settings, palette/search focus, Tab, Escape, Back/Forward, ZoomOut, and copy on macOS, Windows, Linux. Every visible button changes route/state or gives typed unavailable.

Use root/nested .gitignore plus target/node_modules/dist/build/bin/obj/coverage and one generated file over the per-file limit. Ignored dirs are not descended; oversized file is TooLarge; unrelated files index.
Start cold on macOS, Windows, Linux and validate canonical path, endpoint ownership, stdio/loopback, reconnect after service restart, and platform-correct credentials/shortcuts.

deltas.finding: Project selection/onboarding is incomplete; package lanes, source, graph, and docs actions are placeholders; ProjectId::new(1) is constructed by the runtime client.
deltas.remediation: Add one typed SurfaceReply-to-snapshot projection, allocate stable project IDs from local-service state, route existing buttons through ActionId/Route, and persist shelf/project identity at the model boundary.

deltas.finding: Transport exists, but historical tool/resource names and visible setup/status/config-copy behavior are not a proven client contract.
deltas.remediation: Freeze current generated schema, add old-name aliases or a versioned compatibility profile, and expose endpoint status/config through Settings.

deltas.finding: Static adapters do not prove a live production journey; forge commands return forge-unavailable.
deltas.remediation: Drive one real package/project fixture per ecosystem and one forge revision through local-service and record typed result/error envelopes for all clients.

deltas.finding: All-language multi-client parity is unproven; C# and JS/TypeScript MCP are explicit regression risks.
deltas.remediation: Add a matrix from source ingest through MCP search/read/refs/graph for seven baseline frontends plus C/C++; keep native authority optional but make baseline/degraded results deterministic.

deltas.finding: Product-state temp rename lacks file/parent fsync; desktop persistence drops Package and Project shelf identities.
deltas.remediation: Add durable commit ordering/recovery diagnostics and a validated desktop schema bump for stable shelf/project identities; fall back to typed unavailable when identity cannot be reconstructed.

deltas.finding: Old entity families, watermarks, object locations, historical reads, and Tantivy ranking fields have no single current parity map.
deltas.remediation: Publish a field-level map to current objects/relations/projections and retain explicit not-recorded/unavailable state rather than zero or empty success.

deltas.finding: Typed registry facts exist but desktop projection is compact/placeholder and live ecosystem coverage is unproven.
deltas.remediation: Complete standing/download/security/dependency/dependent/source/acquisition projections and gate all seven ecosystems with real and offline cases.

deltas.finding: Path foundation exists but platform shortcut, transport, and credential-language behavior is unevenly visible.
deltas.remediation: Derive labels/shortcuts from platform capabilities, bind existing key constants to actions, and run cold transport on all three platforms.

deltas.finding: Some current text says 35 commands while grammar/registry has 40; prior reports refer to retired paths/branches.
deltas.remediation: Update count claims, mark historical reports as snapshots, and add a lightweight citation check.

deltas.finding: Background job progress, copy actions, typed search rows, and richer route affordances from old UI are not fully wired.
deltas.remediation: Finish the existing snapshot/action projection incrementally without restoring a second UI state system or monolithic workspace GUI.

preservation_requirements: Stable project/package/version/symbol/document/source-span/forge identities, selected versions, route identity, active project, shelf membership, and revision/epoch.

Package coordinates/aliases, dependency/dependent edges, release standing, exact/approximate/privileged/withheld/unavailable download counts, advisories/severity, licenses, repository/forge provenance, checksums, archive size, acquisition receipts, and native metadata.
Source producer/language profile, compile/native-authority state, syntax baseline, paths, spans, diagnostics, and typed degraded/unavailable causes for every language.
Index generation, feed/git/sink watermarks, object locations, outbox/replay state, listing events, repository lineage, and schema version.

Tantivy package identity, exact/tokenized names, namespace, description, keywords, ecosystem, record/dependency/license/repository fields, quality, downloads, popularity, schema/watermark/partial-index state.

Semantic model/recipe identity, vector coverage, endpoint state, graph query authority, MCP endpoint/session identity, transport/bearer configuration, resource URI meaning, tool schema version, and reconnect/error classification.

validation.static_reference_review: Completed during source audit; report references are repository-relative exact files/symbols.
validation.json_parser: Run after writing with Python standard json.tool.
validation.git_whitespace: Run after writing with git diff --check.
validation.git_scope: Run after writing; only the Markdown and JSON review files should be changed.

remaining_risks: Desktop project identity, shelf persistence, and package/source/graph/settings live projections remain incomplete.
Current MCP transport is a foundation, but generated names/results/resources and missing desktop setup/status are not proven historical Claude/client compatibility.
No reviewed evidence proves one live all-language journey through ingest, search/read/references/graph, CLI, MCP, and desktop; C# and JavaScript/TypeScript are explicit risks.
Product-state durability and warm/offline/corrupt restart recovery are incomplete or unproven with real identities.
Typed registry, Tantivy, Qdrant, Trustfall, and forge owners exist, but historical index record families and seven-ecosystem/forge facts are not proven end to end in current clients.
